answer: The juniper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ledge is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The basalt of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a developer-centric, implementation details matter register, it stays short. The design leans on quadratic voting for sybil resistance. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
